name: Royal Purple Team Parade
direction: Create a festive Thai school sports-day poster in deep violet, magenta, white, and championship gold. Make sweeping running-track lanes, coordinated team-color pennants, victory ribbons, and bright field lights immediately visible. Use a symmetrical gold victory arc behind the portrait, bold donor-name lettering, and a white ticket-style information card with sporty curved cutouts.

name: Emerald Field Day
direction: Create a bright Thai school sports-day field atmosphere in emerald, fresh green, ivory, and warm gold. Use athletic-field markings, team tents or flag shapes, medal details, and lively color-team streamers while retaining an official school finish. Place a refined victory medallion behind the portrait and use a structured ivory information card with clipped athletic geometry.

name: Sapphire Stadium Night
direction: Create an energetic Thai school sports-day evening scene using midnight navy, electric sapphire, crisp white, and polished silver with gold accents. Feature sweeping stadium-light beams, running-track curves, team-color flags, motion trails, and a friendly championship atmosphere. Frame the portrait with a sleek circular victory arc and use a modern glass-and-white information card.

name: Thai Silk Color Games
direction: Create a Thai school sports-day poster that combines burgundy and gold silk-inspired texture with unmistakable color-team competition. Shape the woven accents into track curves, team ribbons, pennants, and medal-like geometry rather than a ceremonial textile display. Use delicate gold victory framing behind the portrait and a cream information card with a disciplined double-line border.

name: Sunrise Opening Ceremony
direction: Create an uplifting Thai school sports-day opening-ceremony atmosphere with coral, peach, amber, soft rose, and luminous cream. Show a sunlit school field, curved track lanes, rising team-color flags, victory ribbons, and warm celebratory energy. Use a radiant sports-emblem frame behind the portrait and a softly rounded cream information card.

name: Modern Minimal Track
direction: Create a clean editorial Thai school sports-day poster with warm ivory, charcoal, muted taupe, violet, and restrained gold. Use generous negative space but make precise running-track lines, lane curves, small team-color blocks, and medal geometry clearly establish the sports event. Present the portrait as a premium cutout and use a crisp architectural information panel with subtle depth.

name: Crimson Color Champion
direction: Create a bold Thai school sports-day championship design in deep crimson, black cherry, bright white, and trophy gold. Add running-lane diagonals, coordinated color-team banners, controlled speed lines, stadium haze, and compact victory sparks. Use a strong sports-crest frame behind the portrait and a high-contrast white information card with energetic angled details.

name: Blue Victory Lights
direction: Create a celebratory Thai school sports-day poster in deep indigo, sky blue, pearl white, and soft gold. Replace generic celestial imagery with stadium floodlights, illuminated track arcs, scoreboard-inspired geometry without numbers, team pennants, and glowing victory points. Use a radiant circular sports frame behind the portrait and a pearl information card with luminous edging.

name: Rose Gold Team Spirit
direction: Create a graceful but energetic Thai school sports-day poster using dusty rose, mauve, cream, violet, and metallic rose gold. Form the translucent accents into track sweeps, relay-like motion ribbons, color-team flags, and small medal details rather than floral decoration. Use a flowing oval victory frame behind the portrait and a cream card with rose-gold athletic linework.

name: Teal Community Games
direction: Create a friendly Thai school sports-day community atmosphere in deep teal, turquoise, sea green, white, and warm gold. Use overlapping track waves, circular team-connection motifs, school-field markings, coordinated flags, and bright daytime energy. Frame the portrait with balanced victory ribbons and use a white information card with a slim teal-and-gold border.

name: Golden Sports Heritage
direction: Create a dignified Thai school sports-day poster in rich black, warm parchment, bronze, purple, and luminous gold. Use engraved running-track lines, classic medal and trophy geometry, laurel details, and coordinated team-color pennants so the sports event remains dominant over the heritage finish. Place a ceremonial victory arch behind the portrait and use a premium parchment-white information card.

name: Fresh Green School Field
direction: Create a bright daytime Thai school sports-day celebration with deep grass green, lime highlights, white, blue sky accents, and sunny gold. Feature a recognizable school athletic field, curved running lanes, color-team flags, finish-line ribbons, and lively but orderly streamers. Place a clean victory-ring frame behind the portrait and use a bright white information card with energetic rounded geometry.

name: Festival Stadium Glow
direction: Create a festive evening Thai school sports-day design with plum, deep navy, glowing amber, and gold. Use stadium lights, illuminated running-track arcs, suspended team pennants, trophy highlights, and cheering-stand energy instead of lantern-festival scenery. Surround the portrait with a warm victory arch and use a cream information card with softly glowing sporty edges.

name: Silver Future Athletics
direction: Create a forward-looking Thai school sports-day poster in graphite, cool navy, silver, ice blue, and white. Build the design from precise lane lines, timing-inspired geometry without numbers, translucent team-color panels, stadium-light strips, and dynamic athletic motion. Frame the portrait with a sleek silver victory arc and use a clean frosted-white information card.

name: Watercolor Color Games
direction: Create an artistic Thai school sports-day poster with controlled watercolor washes in violet, cobalt, turquoise, green, red, yellow, and warm gold over ivory. Shape the paint into running-track sweeps, coordinated team flags, motion ribbons, and medal accents while keeping all text areas solid and clean. Use a soft painted victory ring behind the realistic portrait and a solid ivory information card.

name: Paper Cut Sports Fest
direction: Create a layered-paper Thai school sports-day poster in purple, blue, green, red, yellow, white, and gold. Build dimensional running lanes, folded team pennants, finish-line ribbons, trophy shapes, and stadium tiers with clean paper-cut curves and realistic shadows. Keep the donor portrait photographic within a layered victory frame and use a raised white information card.

name: Art Deco Victory Track
direction: Create a glamorous Art Deco Thai school sports-day poster in black, deep purple, ivory, and metallic gold. Transform fan geometry and stepped borders into symmetrical running lanes, victory podium lines without numbers, team-color pennants, and disciplined medal motifs. Place the portrait within a geometric sports-victory arch and use a crisp ivory information card with gold athletic linework.

name: Blue and Gold School Games
direction: Create a classic institutional Thai school sports-day poster in royal blue, navy, white, and warm gold. Use school-field banners, running-track borders, coordinated red-blue-green-yellow team flags, trophy ribbons, and restrained victory confetti without inventing a seal or logo. Frame the portrait with a dignified laurel-and-track motif and use a structured white information card.

name: Tropical Field Morning
direction: Create a fresh morning Thai school sports-day atmosphere with jade, turquoise, pale sky blue, warm sunlight, and gold. Show a sunlit athletic field, sweeping track lanes, team tents or flags, finish-line ribbons, and light tropical foliage only at the outer edges. Use a delicate victory oval behind the portrait and a clean cream information card with fine gold edging.

name: Magenta Relay Energy
direction: Create a vibrant modern Thai school sports-day poster with deep violet, vivid magenta, coral, white, and metallic gold. Use relay-inspired motion ribbons, curved running lanes, coordinated color-team flags, stadium-light streaks, and controlled victory particles to express momentum. Frame the portrait with a dynamic track-shaped loop and use a bold white information card with sculpted sporty edges.
